{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`
  # must not be part of an image edit: any clear/upload drafts it and
  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled
    [managed, all - managed]
  end

  # The languages this sync may manage (the managed half of
  # managed_and_skipped).
  def managed_locales(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: skip_untitled).first
  end","oldText":"  # gh-1402: the languages this sync may manage — store-side listings with

  # The listing-texts deploy in the same lane (supply) creates/completes
  # those listings; their images sync on a later run. skip_untitled: false
  # restores full management ("unless explicitly adding one").
  def managed_locales(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return all unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    all & titled
  end

Wait — there's a subtle behavior change: the original `managed_locales` with `skip_untitled: true` returned `all & titled` — the union INTERSECTED with titled languages. `all` = repo ∪ listing languages. `titled` = titled LISTING languages only. `all & titled` = titled languages that are also in the union — since titled ⊆ listing languages ⊆ all, `all & titled == titled`... but SORTED? `all` is `.uniq.sort` (from all_locales). `&` preserves the receiver's order (Array#& returns elements of the left array in order, dedup). So `all & titled` = titled∩all sorted by all's order (which is sorted). My refactor: `managed = all & titled` — identical. `skipped = all - managed` — Array#- preserves receiver order (all is sorted) → skipped is sorted. Original code in sync_and_verify: `skipped = all_locales(...) - managed` → also sorted. Same. Good.

One more check — original `managed_locales` returned `all` (sorted) for skip_untitled: false; mine returns `[all, []].first` = all. Same object semantics. Good.

That's a zip artifact: the original zip is highly compressed (small text compresses well); re-zipping with `-9` from the extracted tree can grow the archive (stored vs deflated differences, no duplicate-string matches across entries, plus directory entries added by `zip -r`). {"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`
  # must not be part of an image edit: any clear/upload drafts it and
  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled
    [managed, all - managed]

Wait — there's a subtle behavior change: the original `managed_locales` with `skip_untitled: true` returned `all & titled` — the union INTERSECTED with titled languages. `all` = repo ∪ listing languages. `titled` = titled LISTING languages only. `all & titled` = titled languages that are also in the union — since titled ⊆ listing languages ⊆ all, `all & titled == titled`... but SORTED? `all` is `.uniq.sort` (from all_locales). `&` preserves the receiver's order (Array#& returns elements of the left array in order, dedup). So `all & titled` = titled∩all sorted by all's order (which is sorted). My refactor: `managed = all & titled` — identical. `skipped = all - managed` — Array#- preserves receiver order (all is sorted) → skipped is sorted. Original code in sync_and_verify: `skipped = all_locales(...) - managed` → also sorted. Same. Good.

  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })

{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`

  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled
    [managed, all - managed]
  end

  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also

  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`

  # explicitly adding one").

  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled

{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`
  # must not be part of an image edit: any clear/upload drafts it and
  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled
    [managed, all - managed]
  end

  # The languages this sync may manage (the managed half of
  # managed_and_skipped).
  def managed_locales(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: skip_untitled).first

  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or

  # explicitly adding one").

  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled

{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`
  # must not be part of an image edit: any clear/upload drafts it and
  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled
    [managed, all - managed]
  end

  # The languages this sync may manage (the managed half of
  # managed_and_skipped).
  def managed_locales(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: skip_untitled).first
  end","oldText":"  # gh-1402: the languages this sync may manage — store-side listings with

    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })

blocks.text:
Progress — the step now exits 0, but my size assertion failed: `IPA stripped: 1119 -> ...`? Let me see the full output. Expected `beforeBytes == before` (the file size I wrote = 1119) but the reported BEFORE is... wait: `Actual: <1119> Which: is not a value less than <951>`. So `afterBytes (1119) < beforeBytes (951)` failed — BEFORE=951, AFTER=1119. The stripped IPA is BIGGER than the original?

That's a zip artifact: the original zip is highly compressed (small text compresses well); re-zipping with `-9` from the extracted tree can grow the archive (stored vs deflated differences, no duplicate-string matches across entries, plus directory entries added by `zip -r`). In real IPAs the Symbols dir is ~99 MB of dSYM binaries — stripping always shrinks. In my fixture, the Symbols payload is only 20480 bytes of 'dwarf' repeats... hmm, wait: 'dwarf' * 4096 = 20480 bytes, highly compressible → tiny in the zip. So my "diet" assertion is fixture-sensitive.

Also BEFORE=951: the original fixture zip with all content compressed. AFTER=1119 (re-zipped tree, plus dir entries zip adds).

The "shrank" assertion is the wrong pin for a synthetic fixture — the REAL contract: the step strips Symbols/ and leaves a valid IPA with Payload intact. The size report line should still exist (BEFORE/AFTER printed), but asserting AFTER < BEFORE on a tiny synthetic fixture is not the invariant. What IS invariant: the stripped zip no longer contains the Symbols ENTRIES (uncompressed content shrank even if zip framing grows). I'll assert:
- entries: Symbols gone, Payload intact (already asserted)
- the report line exists and BEFORE/AFTER are both non-zero
- the total uncompressed size shrank: sum of uncompressed sizes of remaining entries < before uncompressed total? Simpler: assert the Symbols DWARF entry content (20480 bytes) is absent → implied by Symbols/ entries gone.

Actually — could ALSO make the fixture payload big & incompressible (random bytes) so zip framing differences are dwarfed and AFTER < BEFORE holds robustly... Generating random bytes in Dart: Random().nextInt. 512 KiB random → incompressible → both zips carry it raw. Original zip = stored/deflated-random ≈ 512K + overhead; stripped = 512K + smaller overhead → strictly smaller. That makes the diet assertion meaningful (it pins the step actually removing the bulk, guarding against a no-op strip). I like that better: use ~256 KiB random for the DWARF entry, and assert after < before. Random bytes: `List.generate(n, (_) => _rng.nextInt(256))`.

But careful: ZipEncoder may STORE (not deflate) incompressible data — fine either way; sizes match the raw bytes.

Also BEFORE must equal the fixture byte size I returned: with incompressible payloads, encoded zip ≈ 512K + small → BEFORE ≈ encoded length. My assertion `expect(beforeBytes, before)` — BEFORE is `stat -f%z` of the file = exact byte length; `writeIpa` returns bytes.length. Exact match holds regardless. Good.

Keep BOTH: entries assertions (behavioral contract) + size-shrank (no-op guard). Update the fixture: DWARF entry = 256 KiB random. Then re-zip overhead (~KBs) won't flip the comparison.

  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })

{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`
  # must not be part of an image edit: any clear/upload drafts it and
  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled

{"newText":"  # gh-1402: the locale PARTITION the sync works on — [managed, skipped].
  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or
  # console-created alike; a repo locale with no store listing yet is also
  # untouchable, the upload would draft it title-less). skipped = the
  # untitled remainder of the same union. A language outside `managed`

  # Google rejects the WHOLE edit at commit (HTTP 403 "This app has no
  # title for language <lang>"). The listing-texts deploy in the same lane
  # (supply) creates/completes those listings; their images sync on a
  # later run. skip_untitled: false restores full management ("unless
  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    titled = listings.reject { |listing| listing["title"].to_s.strip.empty? }
                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled

  end

  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })

  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })

                     .map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") }
    managed = all & titled

  # managed = store-side listings with a NON-EMPTY title (repo-backed or

  # explicitly adding one").
  #
  # The union is computed ONCE here (gh-1405 review): callers wanting both
  # halves must use this, not re-derive the union for the skipped set.
  def managed_and_skipped(metadata_dir, listings, skip_untitled: true)
    all = all_locales(metadata_dir, listings.map { |listing| listing.fetch("language") })
    return [all, []] unless skip_untitled

    managed = all & titled

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg

    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg

    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:

    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):

  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.

runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
{"command":"dart test --exclude-tags integration --concurrency=4 2>&1 | tail -25","background":true}

{"content":"### Root Cause

The testflight leg's `Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)` step failed because `find` yields a **relative** `IPA_PATH`, and the rezip runs inside `(cd "$STRIP" && … zip "$IPA_PATH.stripped")` — after the `cd`, the output path resolved against the mktemp dir, which has no `flutter_app/` ancestor → `zip error: Could not create output file` → `set -euo pipefail` killed the step. Latent since #1331: every prior IPA took the `no Symbols/` early-exit guard, so the main path had zero executions until this week's build shipped an IPA with `Symbols/`.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: absolutize once, right after discovery — `IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")` after the `-z` guard. The `cd` subshell is now harmless, and the atomic-swap `mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"` (same relative-path hazard) is correct too.
- Folded in the four non-blocking review follow-ups on #1405 (same fastlane area): removed dead `PlayListingSync.untitled_locales`; removed production-orphaned `list_locales!`/`clear_plan` (+ comment updates); the skipped set now comes from `managed_and_skipped` — the locale union is computed once instead of re-derived in `sync_and_verify!`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` — new `gh-1403` group executes the exact run block against a fixture IPA (`test_bench_workflow.py` extract-and-execute pattern; BSD `stat -f%z` shimmed for ubuntu CI):
  - `an IPA WITH Symbols/ is stripped in place` — **RED before the fix** with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`), **green after**; also pins the guard path (untouched pass-through) and the missing-IPA `::error::`.
  - Release workflow suite: 61 tests passed. Workflow-guard neighbors (pub-get retry, store automation, nightly desktop, selfhosted setup, dispatch watch): 126 passed.
- `flutter_app/fastlane/test/play_listing_sync_test.rb` — new pins: `managed_and_skipped` partition, and the headline **gate-before-any-network-call ordering** (`sync_and_verify!` on an incomplete tree makes zero transport calls). Full fastlane loop: 133 checks passed (5 suites).
- Full `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: passing (see CI).

### Notes

- Why `Symbols/` appeared now: toolchain drift, not a config change — the fastlane `build_only` export options are untouched since #1331; the runner's newer Xcode now emits the debug-symbols directory into app-store IPAs at export. App Store Connect strips `Symbols/` from device delivery anyway, so the #1331 repack remains the right shape; nothing else to change.
- `realpath` is used in the macOS-runner step: present since macOS 13 (`/usr/bin/realpath`); the runner is far newer (Xcode 26 toolchain).
- Owner action: rerun `daily-publish` manually after this lands — acceptance is the testflight leg green through the strip step with `Symbols/` present.
